title: Hogan vs. Warrior: The Ultimate Challenge
summary: WWF’s two leading fan favorites collide, then put both singles championships on the line. Warrior’s challenge offers an alternative to Hogan at the top.

chapters.title: Hogan and Warrior collide in the Rumble
chapters.result: Hogan eliminates Warrior on his way to winning the Rumble.
chapters.context: The confrontation puts the two champions on a collision course.

chapters.title: Warrior wins the champion-vs.-champion match
chapters.result: Warrior defeats Hogan to add the WWF title to his Intercontinental championship.
chapters.context: The Ultimate Challenge ends with Warrior holding both titles.
